newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel Corp cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel Corp cut to hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it downgraded Intel Corp to hold from strong buy.
-- said cut the 1997 estimate to $8.90 a share from $9.00 a share.
-- said cut the 1998 estimate to $10.00 a share from $11.00 a share.
-- cited lower margin assumptions in the second half and slower sales growth in the second quarter.
-- said near-term stock price performance is likely to be limited by gross margin pressure.
-- said expects higher depreciation growth in the second half of 1997. Said this will increase cost of goods sold.
-- said Intel will ship more lower-margin products in the second half, such as motherboards for its new Pentium II microprocessor.
-- said believes Intel will have to cut prices on its older products to make room for the launch of the Pentium II.
-- said expects Advanced Micro Devices Inc will get very aggreesive on K6 prices in the second half of 1997.
-- said estimates are likely to be revised downward as analysts factor in a lower gross margin in the second half.
-- said personal computer market continues to grow in "healthy fashion."
-- said Intel enjoys strong brand name recognition, excellant management and strong balance sheet.
